page.layout: One page of running text with a running head at the top centre; a small page number at the foot centre.

main_text.p: decus Iosephus Scaliger, qui nuperis literis ad Clariss. de Vic, Casaubonum eruditorum Phænicem appellat. Ita sentiunt suis eulogiis praeclara illa sydera Aug. Thuanus, Petrus Faber Saniorianus, Iustus Lipsius, quorum nomini totus literatorum concessus plaudit & assurgit. Sic sentient omnes quibus est purior sensus. Reliquos qui plus verborum quam animi habent, quibus innatum est, & veluti οἰκεῖον[?] πρῶτον magnis inuidere conatibus, homines dodrantales, ignauiones usquequaq; contemnendos non moramur. Sed ne diutius te detineam, candide Lector, his praeclaris ingenij deliciis plane, plane tuis diu fruere, & Vale.

page.notes: The first word "decus" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "Phænicem" (the ligature may be æ or œ); the Greek word after "veluti" reads as οἰκεῖον, with the accents and the following πρῶτον uncertain. The page number "1" at the foot is small and may be a signature or other mark; it is read here as a page number. Long s is transcribed as s throughout.
